snippet.title: LEGO® Party! Launch Trailer – Endless Minigames & Laughs
snippet.description:
Let the party begin! Gather your friends because LEGO® Party! is available now! 

LEGO Party! is a cross-platform party game for up to four players that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO® and more. Join your friends online no matter their platform, for a LEGO Party game night. 

Find out more at www.legoparty.com 

Social Fly Through - Ninjago 
Are you the ultimate ninja? 🥷Put your skills to the test by collecting the most golden bricks in the NINJAGO® zone! 

Social Fly Through - Pirate 
Ahoy, matey! 🏴 ☠️Sail into the LEGO® Pirate zone for some swashbuckling fun and win some golden treasure! 

Social Fly Through - Theme Park 
Get ready for a wild ride in our LEGO® theme park challenge zone! 🎢
 
Social Fly Through - Space 
Blast Off! LEGO® Party! is almost here! Get ready to journey across galaxies in our LEGO Space challenge zone. 

Social SGF Reactions 01 
This is what LEGO® Party! feels like! 

Social SGF Reactions 02 
LEGO® Bricks + A Gazillion Minifigures + Amazing Minigames = The ultimate party! 🎉

Welcome to the official LEGO channel where everything is awesome!

This is the home for all your latest LEGO movies, animations and series from your favorite LEGO themes such as LEGO NINJAGO, LEGO Star Wars, The LEGO Batman Movie, LEGO Minecraft, LEGO Marvel Super Heroes, LEGO DC Super Heroes, LEGO City, LEGO Friends and many more to come in exclusive episodes and stop motion videos.
  
You can also find hundreds of LEGO songs and LEGO movie trailers. And that’s not all! – you can be one of the first to discover our cool new sets with exclusive behind the scenes LEGO Designer videos.

Become a LEGO® Insiders Club member and get insider access to how-to videos, building challenges and unlockable trophies. Join now: https://lego.build/Signup
